title: Forecasting on CPUs, diffusion speed, and a Mistral test
summary: Mistral releases Timestral, an open time-series forecasting model that runs on plain CPUs. Also: Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model and its pricing, Mistral Large 4 open weights due October twenty-seventh, an MLflow security flaw to check, and the December second AI Act marking deadline.
